ZKTeco ETK-45A-ID biometric reader
nodes.rationale: Primary source of raw attendance records; stores time as packed 32-bit integer (seconds since ~2000), communicates via TCP 192.168.15.50:4370

nodes.label: CHECKINOUT table - raw device attendance records
nodes.rationale: Contains 44,913 raw device records; composite key (USERID+CHECKTIME+CHECKTYPE); all rows share sn=CGCA211460361

nodes.label: CHECKEXACT table - manual operations log
nodes.rationale: Contains 3 manual ISADD records; uses ISADD/ISDELETE/ISMODIFY flags; linked to CHECKINOUT via composite key

nodes.label: USERINFO table - user mapping (USERID→BADGENUMBER)
nodes.rationale: Maps internal Access USERID to BADGENUMBER (=zkUserId); 60 users defined; critical missing link for user 54 (BADGENUMBER=1069)

nodes.label: att2000.mdb - Microsoft Access database
nodes.rationale: Designated as Reference Source of Truth; owned exclusively by Temp-Supervisor; must be read-only from our side

nodes.label: MongoDB Atlas - Output Layer
nodes.rationale: Only writable layer in the system; stores Attendance and User models; unique index on (employee, date)

nodes.label: Bridge Service (bridge/index.js)
nodes.rationale: Core connector between ZKTeco device and backend; uses dual connection architecture with node-zklib and SDK Bridge

nodes.label: SDK Bridge - 32-bit PowerShell COM wrapper
nodes.rationale: Wraps zkemkeeper.dll via COM; communicates via TCP 127.0.0.1:3457; required for writing operations and reliable device info

nodes.label: node-zklib library (v1.3.0)
nodes.rationale: Primary attendance reader; supports cursor-based reading; uses TCP protocol; parses time via parseTimeToDate()

nodes.label: zkemkeeper.dll - Official ZKTeco COM SDK
nodes.rationale: Official 32-bit COM library; needed for device write operations; not usable directly from Node.js - requires PowerShell wrapper

nodes.label: Temp-Supervisor desktop application
nodes.rationale: Sole owner of att2000.mdb; adds/modifies/deletes attendance records; its operations must be reflected on the website

nodes.label: Merge Engine (proposed)
nodes.rationale: NEW component that merges CHECKINOUT + CHECKEXACT → MongoDB; applies ISDELETE/ISADD/ISMODIFY rules; reads att2000.mdb read-only

nodes.label: Event Interpretation Engine philosophy
nodes.rationale: Core design philosophy: system interprets events rather than editing databases; no UPDATE or DELETE - only INSERT + logical hide/show

nodes.label: ISADD - Manual fingerprint add operation
nodes.rationale: Record not in device; 3 existing records for USERID=1 and USERID=54; added to final result with dedup check

nodes.label: ISDELETE - Manual fingerprint hide operation
nodes.rationale: Hides record from result without deleting from CHECKINOUT; identified by composite key match; 0 records currently

nodes.label: ISMODIFY - Manual fingerprint modify operation
nodes.rationale: Needs manual testing to confirm pattern; presumed to create ISDELETE+ISADD pair; 0 records currently; marked as UNCONFIRMED

nodes.label: USERID→BADGENUMBER→zkUserId mapping chain
nodes.rationale: Chain: Access USERID→USERINFO.BADGENUMBER→system zkUserId→MongoDB User._id; 60 Access users vs 6 known system users; BADGENUMBER=1069 is orphan

nodes.label: Dual Connection Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses node-zklib for fast cursor-based attendance reading AND SDK Bridge for reliable device info/writing; fallback: if SDK Bridge unavailable, bridge uses only node-zklib

nodes.label: Fingerprint Forgotten flow
nodes.rationale: When approved: creates Attendance record + attempts device injection via executeCmd(CMD_DATA_WRRQ, 40-byte buffer); non-blocking

nodes.label: Attendance model - MongoDB schema
nodes.rationale: Fields: employee, date, checkIn/checkOut, duration, expectedHours, overtime, status, leave FK; unique index (employee, date)

nodes.label: User model with zkUserId field
nodes.rationale: Links system user to device user ID via zkUserId (sparse index); 6 mapped users, 8 unmapped

nodes.label: Source of Truth hierarchy
nodes.rationale: 1. att2000.mdb (primary - has raw + manual edits), 2. ZKTeco device (real-time new fingerprints), 3. MongoDB (cached output layer)

nodes.label: Merge rules - ISDELETE, ISADD, ISMODIFY
nodes.rationale: Rule 1: Result = CHECKINOUT; Rule 2: exclude ISDELETE; Rule 3: add ISADD (dedup); Rule 4: handle ISMODIFY (needs testing); Rule 5: map USERID→zkUserId

nodes.label: Append-Only system pattern
nodes.rationale: No UPDATE or DELETE operations exist; all operations are INSERT (CHECKINOUT from device, CHECKEXACT from supervisor); hides via logical deletion

nodes.label: Hardcoded credentials security issue
nodes.rationale: MongoDB credentials exposed in .env in git; JWT_SECRET weak default; admin password forced to 'admin123'; security score 2/10 CRITICAL

nodes.label: Multi-Repo Subtree Strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses git subtree to push backend/→backendradio.git and frontend/→radio.git; deployed to Render and Netlify

nodes.label: Payroll - Attendance integration
nodes.rationale: Payroll references Attendance; PayrollItem resolves LeaveRequest/Task; compensation calculation synced via syncCompensationToPayroll()

nodes.label: Deduplication strategy
nodes.rationale: MongoDB unique index (employee, date); merge-level check (zkUserId, CHECKTIME, CHECKTYPE); upsert via findOneAndUpdate; 60-second tolerance for check-in/check-out
